run_metadata.coverage_summary: SEVERELY DEGRADED RUN. The environment's network egress policy blocked ALL WebFetch requests this run — every host was refused (gov and non-gov alike: tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, and even en.wikipedia.org all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED). Only the WebSearch tool was available, which returns titles, URLs and short synthesised snippets but does not allow opening a tender's detail page, following RSS/JSON feeds, or paginating a portal. As a result no deliverables/requirements extraction was possible and only a small number of opportunities that surfaced with a concrete buyer, title and closing date directly in search snippets could be captured — all at headline level. This is not representative of the source universe; the vast majority of live opportunities across Tier 1/2/3 could not be reached this run.
gaps: CRITICAL: All WebFetch/egress was blocked by the environment network policy this run. Every URL fetched returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including non-government hosts (en.wikipedia.org tested as a control). Only WebSearch was functional.

Tier 1 core portals could not be read directly: AusTender (tenders.gov.au), NSW eTendering (tenders.nsw.gov.au), Buying for Victoria (tenders.vic.gov.au), QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders. No feeds, no ATM lists, no pagination.
No detail/deliverables extraction was possible for ANY opportunity: tender detail pages and documents were unreachable. All captured tenders are headline-level only (see entries_pending_detail).

Tier 3 (mandatory): SAP Ariba Discovery and all major-buyer corporate portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos, energy) were unreachable via WebFetch and login-gated; no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be confirmed this run. Recorded as gaps rather than fabricated.
Source discovery was limited to whatever WebSearch surfaced; the platform sibling-buyer discovery technique (which needs page fetches) could not be run.

Excluded as stale/unverifiable (dates in the past or could not confirm still-open without a fetch): Tamworth Regional Council RFQ Q041-2026 (snippet gave closing 6 Nov 2025 — past); Melbourne Water Capital Program Partnership EOI (snippet dated Mar 2025); SA Water Millicent WWTP EOI (undated in snippet); various aggregator listings (australiantenders.com.au, tenderhub.com.au, govmarket.com.au, bidio.ai, consolidatedtenders.com, tendersontime.com) were treated only as discovery signals, not source-of-truth.
Because pagination and feeds were unavailable, the count of opportunities found is a floor, not a representative sample. Recommend re-running once WebFetch/egress access is restored.
